title: Requirements inventory (collected, organised, analysed)

rows.requirement: Maintain one collected, organised, analysed list of requirements for the whole project
rows.source_quote: "The goal of this project is to collect, organize, and analyze utilizing a full list of requirements."

rows.requirement: Analyse the requirement list, not just store it (gap, conflict, dependency analysis)
rows.source_quote: "collect, organize, and analyze utilizing a full list of requirements"

rows.requirement: Ship a dedicated suggestions section that someone reviews before anything is built
rows.source_quote: "create a section dedicated for suggestions so someone can review suggestions and choose the best path before implementing any changes"

rows.requirement: Every suggestion must present more than one path so a reviewer can choose, not just approve
rows.source_quote: "choose the best path before implementing any changes"

rows.requirement: Publish the questions, the information we have, and the information we do not have, before any decision is made
rows.source_quote: "I want a clear list of questions, informations and answers that need to be addressed before any decision can be reasonably made bases upon the information that we already have and do not have."

rows.requirement: Suggest concrete ways to discover the missing information, not just note that it is missing
rows.source_quote: "Suggestions need to be made to discover missing information."

rows.requirement: Originate our own NFL lines rather than reuse someone else's numbers
rows.source_quote: "I want to originate my own NFL lines."
rows.status: Partially implemented — needs a market price feed (see Q-02)

rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
rows.source_quote: "Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals."

rows.requirement: Run the strategy set as a leaderboard competition
rows.source_quote: "Treat it as a leaderboard competition"

rows.requirement: Provide rewards for the top performing strategies
rows.source_quote: "that provides rewards for top performing strategies"

rows.requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop bet combinations
rows.source_quote: "Look at single bet, parlays, player prop bet combos."

rows.requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates before it is allowed to bet
rows.source_quote: "Each strategy must pass validation gates."
rows.status: Implemented (gates defined, no strategy has passed yet)

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values between the signals and markets we use
rows.source_quote: "Determine correlation values."
rows.status: Implemented for team-stat pairs; player/market pairs blocked

rows.requirement: Remove luck from the equation; keep only selectively skill-based strategies
rows.source_quote: "Remove luck from the equation and build strategies that are selectively skill based."

rows.requirement: Track injuries continuously
rows.source_quote: "The system should be tracking injuries"
rows.status: Implemented (official NFL injury report, scheduled refresh)

rows.requirement: Identify defensive deficiencies caused by backups having to replace starters
rows.source_quote: "know any deficiencies in defenses such as 2nd,3rd or 4th string backups having to replace starters due to lineups"
rows.status: Implemented for clubs whose official depth chart is reachable (see Flagged for Review)

rows.requirement: Do the same for offense: know whether a starter or a backup is playing
rows.source_quote: "Also same can be said for offenses using starters or backups."

rows.requirement: Produce an executive summary of the important details
rows.source_quote: "Create an executive summary outlining important details."

rows.requirement: Operate with no manual input from the owner
rows.source_quote: "There should be no manual input on my part."

rows.requirement: Work line by line from official, verified, trusted sources; no hallucinations
rows.source_quote: "Work line by line, verify everything from official verified trusted sources, no hallucinations."

rows.requirement: Review the repo line by line and provide links for manual review
rows.source_quote: "Review the repo. Work line by line verifying from official verified trusted sources, and provide links for manual review."

rows.requirement: Flag irregularities for review
rows.source_quote: "Flag any irregularities for review."

rows.requirement: Publish a GitHub Pages site for this repo
rows.source_quote: "Create a github page live site for this repo"

rows.requirement: Clean landing page plus subpages organised by category
rows.source_quote: "with a clean landing page and subpages organized by category"

rows.requirement: UI must be clean, user friendly, simple and dashboard-like
rows.source_quote: "The UI should be clean, user friendly, simple, and easy to use, like a simple dashboard."

rows.requirement: All entries and findings in simple, easy to read tables, including analysis
rows.source_quote: "It should contain all entries and findings in a simple, easy to read table format, and include any analysis and findings."

rows.requirement: Every table row must carry a source link to an official site
rows.source_quote: "Every table row must have a source link to an official site."

rows.requirement: Values that cannot be confirmed from an official source stay blank and are flagged
rows.source_quote: "If a value can't be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it as unverified."

rows.requirement: Never infer or fill in a value
rows.source_quote: "Never infer or fill in values."

rows.requirement: Maintain COORDINATION.md as the shared task board with status and owning session
rows.source_quote: "It is the shared task board, listing each task, its status ..., the owning session ID, and the files it touches."

rows.requirement: Claim a task by writing session ID and file scope, then commit and push the claim immediately
rows.source_quote: "Claim a task by writing your session ID and file scope there, then commit and push that claim immediately"

rows.requirement: Never start a task another session has claimed; keep file scopes non-overlapping
rows.source_quote: "never start a task another session has claimed. Keep scopes non-overlapping"

rows.requirement: Each session works on its own branch named session-<id>/<task>
rows.source_quote: "each session works on its own branch (or git worktree) named session-<id>/<task>"
rows.status: Not implemented — this session is pinned to one branch by the harness; logged for review (see F-01)

rows.requirement: Request changes to another session's files through COORDINATION.md instead of editing them
rows.source_quote: "If a task requires changing a file owned by another session, log the request in COORDINATION.md instead of editing it."

rows.requirement: Small, frequent commits and git pull --rebase before every push
rows.source_quote: "Make small, frequent commits, and run git pull --rebase before every push."

rows.requirement: On conflict: stop, resolve without discarding the other session's work, and log it
rows.source_quote: "If you hit a merge conflict, stop, resolve it without discarding the other session's work, and log what happened."

rows.requirement: Record sources, verification performed and irregularities in COORDINATION.md and mark done
rows.source_quote: "When a task is finished, record its sources, the verification performed, and any irregularities in COORDINATION.md and mark it done."

rows.requirement: Never mark anything verified without checking it against an official source and linking it
rows.source_quote: "Never mark anything verified without checking it against an official source, and link that source."

rows.requirement: Shared outputs (table data, site index and navigation) change only in a final integration session
rows.source_quote: "Shared outputs, such as the table data and the site's index and navigation, are changed only by a final integration session once all other tasks are done."
rows.status: Implemented — this session is the only session, so it also acts as the integration session

rows.requirement: A session may take over a task whose claim is over 60 minutes old with no commits, and must log the handoff
rows.source_quote: "If a session crashes or its claim is more than 60 minutes old with no commits, any other session may take over the task and note the handoff in the log."

rows.requirement: Create a pull request to main summarising changes, sources and flagged irregularities
rows.source_quote: "create a pull request from the integration branch to main with a summary of the changes, the sources used, and any flagged irregularities"

rows.requirement: Merge without waiting for approval, confirm GitHub Pages deploys, record the PR link and result
rows.source_quote: "Then merge the pull request without waiting for approval, confirm GitHub Pages deploys successfully, and record the PR link and merge result in COORDINATION.md."

rows.requirement: Flagged and unverified items never block the merge
rows.source_quote: "Flagged irregularities and unverified items do not block the merge."

rows.requirement: Publish flagged items on a clearly labelled Flagged for Review page with source links
rows.source_quote: "Publish them on a clearly labeled "Flagged for Review" page on the site, with the source links"

rows.requirement: If the build, a check or the deploy fails, fix and retry until the site is live; never merge a broken site
rows.source_quote: "If the build, a check, or the deploy fails, fix the problem and retry until the site is live. Do not merge a broken site."

note: Every row quotes the project brief verbatim; open the source link and search the quote to confirm.
